hero_sentence: Interested in the logic of complex systems and the use of AI to understand and solve real-world problems.
about_content_1: I am a last year engineering student at EPITA Lyon, specializing in artificial intelligence and graph-based systems. What drives me most is the underlying logic of the world: understanding how complex systems emerge, evolve, and interact, and how intelligence itself can be modeled and reproduced.
about_content_2: Through my projects, I aim to go beyond simple prediction and explore how artificial intelligence can become a powerful tool for understanding problems, anticipating outcomes, and supporting better decision-making. I learn by building; each project is an opportunity to experiment, face real challenges, make mistakes, and continuously improve.
about_content_3: Naturally curious, I am constantly seeking to expand my knowledge and explore new approaches in machine learning. Whether it's deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, or data analysis, I focus on understanding the fundamental principles behind the methods and applying them to build robust, end-to-end systems.
about_content_4: I am particularly interested in the future of AI systems that can reason, adapt, and collaborate with humans to solve complex real-world problems. My goal is to keep learning, building, and pushing my limits in this fast-evolving field.
contact_message: I'm always open to discussing new projects, creative ideas or opportunities.
more_project: More projects are on the way. Some are already finished, but they need a public version before going live.
